slices.focus: A spontaneous cinema outing sparks Saira to build a curated list of light British comedies
slices.summary: An impromptu visit to a local independent cinema with Tom reveals Saira is tired of serious crime dramas. She starts actively collecting light, rewatchable British comedies for low-energy evenings, creating a categorized list (comfort rewrites, low-effort comedies, sharper options) shared with Tom.
open_loops: Film list needs to be finalized and moved to visible location (fridge/TV)
Tom's picks need to be added to make it shared
Once-a-month cinema habit not yet established
